name: Albedo
title: Kreideprinz
description: A genius known as the Kreideprinz, he is the Chief Alchemist and Captain of the Investigation Team of the Knights of Favonius.

skills.name: Favonius Bladework - Weiss
skills.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 rapid strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

skills.name: Abiogenesis: Solar Isotoma
skills.description:
Albedo creates a Solar Isotoma using alchemy, which deals AoE Geo DMG on appearance.

Solar Isotoma
has the following properties:
·When opponents within the Solar Isotoma field take DMG, the Solar Isotoma will generate Transient Blossoms which deal AoE Geo DMG. DMG dealt scales off Albedo's DEF.
·Transient Blossoms can only be generated once every 2s.
·When a character is located at the locus of the Solar Isotoma, the Solar Isotoma will accumulate Geo power to form a crystallized platform that lifts the character up to a certain height. Only one crystallized platform can exist at a time.
·Solar Isotoma is considered a Geo construct. Only one Solar Isotoma created by Albedo himself can exist at a time.

Hold to designate the location of the skill.
skills.info: This Geo bloom has an unusual property mirrored in the aim of alchemy. To rise from the earth, soar into the sky, and become the sun.

skills.name: Rite of Progeniture: Tectonic Tide
skills.description:
Under Albedo's command, Geo crystals surge and burst forth, dealing AoE Geo DMG in front of him.
If a Solar Isotoma created by Albedo himself is on the field, 7 Fatal Blossoms will be generated in the Solar Isotoma field, bursting violently into bloom and dealing AoE Geo DMG.

Tectonic Tide DMG and Fatal Blossom DMG will not generate Transient Blossoms.
skills.info: Under the Kreideprinz's command, the tectonic tide of creation seethes into life.

passives.name: Calcite Might
passives.description: Transient Blossoms generated by Abiogenesis: Solar Isotoma deal 25% more DMG to opponents whose HP is below 50%.

passives.name: Homuncular Nature
passives.description: Using Rite of Progeniture: Tectonic Tide increases the Elemental Mastery of nearby party members by 125 for 10s.

passives.name: Flash of Genius
passives.description: When Albedo crafts Weapon Ascension Materials, he has a 10% chance to receive double the product.

constellations.name: Flower of Eden
constellations.description: Transient Blossoms generated by Albedo's Abiogenesis: Solar Isotoma regenerate 1.2 Energy for Albedo.

constellations.name: Opening of Phanerozoic
constellations.description:
Transient Blossoms generated by Abiogenesis: Solar Isotoma grant Albedo Fatal Reckoning for 30s:
·Unleashing Rite of Progeniture: Tectonic Tide consumes all stacks of Fatal Reckoning. Each stack of Fatal Reckoning consumed increases the DMG dealt by Fatal Blossoms and Rite of Progeniture: Tectonic Tide's burst DMG by 30% of Albedo's DEF.
·This effect stacks up to 4 times.

constellations.name: Grace of Helios
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Abiogenesis: Solar Isotoma by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Descent of Divinity
constellations.description: Active party members within the Solar Isotoma field have their Plunging Attack DMG increased by 30%.

constellations.name: Tide of Hadean
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Rite of Progeniture: Tectonic Tide by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Dust of Purification
constellations.description: Active party members within the Solar Isotoma field who are protected by a shield created by Crystallize, or when Moondrifts are present within the Solar Isotoma field, have their DMG increased by 17%.

outfits.name: Newmoon Starlight
outfits.description: Albedo's outfit. The Knights of Favonius alchemist's uniform that Albedo often wears when conducting his experiments.

voices.title: Hello
voices.text: I am Albedo, Chief Alchemist of the Knights of Favonius. You carry the aura of the stars, interesting... I would like to study you, if you do not mind. I'm certain we will have many opportunities to be alone in the future.

voices.title: Chat: Still Life
voices.text: What a view... How about a quick break so I can sketch this beautiful scenery?

voices.title: Chat: Investigation
voices.text: "The truth of this world"... *sigh* What could it be?

voices.title: Chat: Reminiscing
voices.text: Going out into the world and investigating, turning the "unknown" into the "known." ...Ahhh, I missed this feeling.

voices.title: When It Rains
voices.text: The soil is moist, ideal for collecting the roots of Boom Blossoms. No please, allow me to handle this.

voices.title: When It Snows
voices.text: Master...

voices.title: When the Sun Is Out
voices.text: Ample light... active biological organisms... Yes, this is a good place to sketch.

voices.title: Good Morning
voices.text: Good morning. Are we going to search for ancient relics today?

voices.title: Good Afternoon
voices.text: Good afternoon. I heard your footsteps. My, it certainly is lively outside of the workshop.

voices.title: Good Evening
voices.text: *sigh* It's gotten quiet outside...

voices.title: Good Night
voices.text: Good night, you go ahead and rest. I will just finish one last experiment before bed... If you are interested in the results, I can discuss them with you tomorrow.

voices.title: About Albedo: Genius
voices.text: Genius? ...A number of people call me that. But I don't think I'm any "genius."

voices.title: About Albedo: Socializing
voices.text: Relationships are... *sigh* quite troublesome. Once you establish a relation with someone, you must continue to maintain it; if you lose contact, you must reestablish the relation. This taxing cycle requires...a lot of time.

voices.title: About Us: Experiments
voices.text: You... want to accompany me while I experiment? I'm honored.\nOh, don't be nervous. My experiments may be dangerous, but no one gets hurt... most of the time.

voices.title: About Us: Assistant
voices.text: Would you oblige me by serving as my assistant? After observing so many experiments, you surely know a good deal about alchemy by now. Relax, we will work together. I don't think you will have any problems. I have faith in my ability to instruct you, and even more faith in your exceptional talents.

voices.title: About the Vision
voices.text: My Vision? Ah, that's nothing more than a tool to aid in my experiments, no different from a beaker or crucible. The one thing about it that really intrigues me is the principle behind how it works... One day, I will uncover its secrets. It's only a matter of time.

voices.title: Something to Share
voices.text: There's something I've always wanted to ask you, but feared rejection and disappointment...\nAhem... I am very interested in your... little floating companion. May I borrow her to investigate for a short while?

voices.title: Interesting Things
voices.text: You would like to know more about petrified trees? Um... ahem. Actually, the petrified trees you have come across in domains aren't that ancient. Truly ancient trees usually grow to around one or two miles in height? Oh, and there's a kind of large spider that lives around their roots — if you tie one up in cape jasmine and lemongrass and sprinkle on some cardamom, smoke it for a few hours — you get a fragrant taste that's simply... unforgettable.

voices.title: About Family
voices.text: Family? Although Alice has always asked me to call her "Mother," when I think of the idea of "family," my master comes to mind first. My earliest memories in life are of going on adventures with her. She taught me the art of alchemy and much knowledge about the world. Perhaps... even the words "family" and "master" are incapable of fully expressing her meaning to me.

voices.title: About Sucrose: Direction
voices.text: Sucrose? I think I more or less understand why she is so dedicated to her research in bio-alchemy... Either way, I'm happy to see her succeed more and more in her endeavors.

voices.title: About Sucrose: Habits
voices.text: Working with Sucrose on alchemy research is quite pleasant, but she has some... stubborn qualities in regards to certain aspects unrelated to research. For example, I have told her numerous times to just call me "Albedo" since we are hardly generations apart, but she insists on addressing me in an excessively formal manner. *sigh* ...Whatever she prefers, I guess.

voices.title: About Lisa
voices.text: Lisa? I always am impressed by the valuable perspectives she brings to discussions. But is a person with her talents satisfied with such a basic occupation as librarian? There must be some hidden reason for this.

voices.title: About Klee
voices.text: Indeed, I view Klee as my younger sister. Whenever she gets herself into some explosive sort of trouble, I can only console myself with the fact that her current destructiveness is nothing compared to that of Miss Alice.

voices.title: About Jean
voices.text: Jean? She has served exceptionally well as Acting Grand Master. One can even say she is more reliable than Grand Master Varka. Perhaps in our hearts, we all eagerly await the day she can become the official Grand Master herself.

voices.title: About Xingqiu
voices.text: Oh, Xingqiu? I find his written works quite interesting. The Yae Publishing House in Inazuma has been asking that I cooperate with a different author for greater royalties. Hmph, do I seem the type to be swayed by a few extra Mora?

voices.title: About Barbara
voices.text: Barbara? She's a very earnest Deaconess. I once had the opportunity to sketch her a simple portrait... What happened to the sketch? Ah yes... Albert offered to purchase it, but I rejected his bid and gave it to the Acting Grand Master. Social relations... really require a lot of effort.

voices.title: About Durin
voices.text: My brother is learning all manner of new things. He's intelligent and passionately philosophical. This sometimes causes difficulties, but it does nothing to dull his passion for the world. His arrival — or should I say, his joining the family — has given me a new understanding of human relations. With my closest kin around, home has become a lively place — which is a positive thing, for sure.

voices.title: About Prune
voices.text: She often comes to me asking about the "nature of being," though our discussions tend to end as soon as I pose a few counter-questions. Still, I'm pleased to say she always returns later with a notebook full of answers.

voices.title: More About Albedo: I
voices.text: Have a question for me? Go ahead, ask. It doesn't take too long to ask a single question, does it? I'm about to begin the final stage of an experiment...

voices.title: More About Albedo: II
voices.text: Oh, by the way. Did you know that without human manipulation, you would need to harness the power of a sun eight times the size of our own in order to naturally create gold?

voices.title: More About Albedo: III
voices.text: The time required to sketch portraits closely correlates with one's mood. I could spend half a day sketching Huffman, while I might only need three strokes of the pencil to sketch Kaeya — one for the face, one for the eyepatch string... and one for the eyepatch.

voices.title: More About Albedo: IV
voices.text: What do I do besides sketching and research...? I will occasionally read novels from Inazuma and Liyue. They contain many fascinating ideas which can sometimes provide me with unexpected inspirations for my own creations.

voices.title: More About Albedo: V
voices.text: Even now, I find the nigredo processing stage of alchemy passed down by my master to be full of mystery. What did my master want to create using this technique...? My research is far from over. I will require your help to investigate further.

voices.title: Albedo's Hobbies
voices.text: Hmm... Besides research, the activity I spend most of my time on is probably sketching. At first I saw it simply as a way to better study the structure of living things and materials so as to aid me in my experiments, but it eventually became a hobby of mine. Indeed, it is a very good way to relax.

voices.title: Albedo's Troubles
voices.text: There's just never enough time, is there? Even when I remove the most troublesome matters from my schedule, I still can't find enough time for everything.

voices.title: Favorite Food
voices.text: I really do enjoy having dessert. How can I put it...? When both physical and mental capacity are spent, high-energy materials further provide a kind of primordial, highly-effective boost.

voices.title: Least Favorite Food
voices.text: What food do I dislike? ...Large portions of meat at restaurants. I have a rather small appetite, so a meal like that only ends up in tragedy — either I overeat and the joy of the taste is lost, or I don't finish it and the food is wasted. I decided to simply not go to restaurants, although that has also meant I must spend more time preparing my own food...

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: I
voices.text: If flavors were colors... this one would be gold.

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: II
voices.text: You're willing to spend so much time on improving your cooking, and that's precisely how you're able to make it taste so good.

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: III
voices.text: This is more than I can manage... maybe we could split it between us?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday. You look especially happy, would you mind if I sketched you? The capacity of our brains is limited, so we are bound to forget things. But when an image is transferred onto paper or canvas, the sketch becomes an extension of our memory. We can remember that past feeling when we later look at the sketch.

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Intro
voices.text: Nigredo is the first step in alchemy, drawing from primordial forms. As beings who live in this world, we must find our own meaning.

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Building Up
voices.text: Albedo is the step in which change begins. Clearing away the excess so we can take on all the knowledge that is available. Would you like to investigate this world with me?

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Climax
voices.text: Rubedo in alchemy refers to the refining of feeling. I feel the refining of my own emotions is also thanks to you.

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Conclusion
voices.text: Citrinitas is the final stage of the alchemical transmutation process. The meaning of the object being transmuted has finally been brought to light, becoming gold and revealing its true value... I too have found my own meaning.

voices.title: Elemental Skill: I
voices.text: Burst forth.

voices.title: Elemental Skill: II
voices.text: Come into being!

voices.title: Elemental Skill: III
voices.text: Live.

voices.title: Elemental Burst: I
voices.text: Moment of birth.

voices.title: Elemental Burst: II
voices.text: Feel this ancient power.

voices.title: Elemental Burst: III
voices.text: Witness my great undertaking.

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: I
voices.text: This world holds many a rare treasure.

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: II
voices.text: If this treasure could talk...

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: III
voices.text: Although it's not gold, it certainly glitters.

voices.title: Low HP: I
voices.text: My calculations were off...

voices.title: Low HP: II
voices.text: Time to reassess...

voices.title: Low HP: III
voices.text: A new strategy's required.

voices.title: Ally at Low HP: I
voices.text: I'll take over from here.

voices.title: Ally at Low HP: II
voices.text: This is too dangerous for you.

voices.title: Fallen: I
voices.text: Ashes to ashes, dust to dust...

voices.title: Fallen: II
voices.text: My... experiment... failed...

voices.title: Fallen: III
voices.text: Seems my research... is over...

voices.title: Light Hit Taken: I
voices.text: Still within my threshold.

voices.title: Heavy Hit Taken: I
voices.text: A miscalculation...

voices.title: Joining Party: I
voices.text: Understood.

voices.title: Joining Party: II
voices.text: Some in-the-field research?

voices.title: Joining Party: III
voices.text: Let's investigate this further.
